column1: # handoff_batteries.tsv -- registry of in-flight compute batteries for tools/status.sh + tools/battery_status.py.
#   name            short slug, used to match this battery against GPU/pool "currently running" text

#   expected_rows   how many result files a COMPLETE battery has (one per seed/cell, excludes *.prov.json sidecars)
#   harvest_cmd     the registered command to inspect a READY battery's landed rows before writing the finding
#   finding_template  a template finding doc to copy the write-up structure from
